customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be of good quality, working well, and budget-friendly, with clean and pure water that tastes good. They appreciate its ease of use and consider it worth the price. However, the durability receives mixed reviews, with multiple customers reporting that the RO membrane fails within 6 months of use. Additionally, customer service experiences are mixed, with some finding it customer-friendly while others report very bad customer care and after-sales service.

Poor customer service, installation don't have enough knowledge asked to buy addition connectors & charged us when all required already comes with unit itself

reviews.author: Chinmay
reviews.title: Good Water Purifier
reviews.body: The product doesn't have a strong body, looks are fine with all the necessary features, no fancy things like mobile app connectivity and touch sensors, just the 3 indicators, technician came on scheduled time and did his job perfectly, overall a good water purifier. one suggestion for buyers, before you buy any water purifier, test your water TDS level and then buy the relevant one, since nowadays you get all varieties, consider buying an RO purifier only if your TDS is above 300+ level or else simply buy UV+UF water purifier and save money.
